items.title: James Chirillo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2007
items.q: My first semester composition class at North Texas... the guy, the teacher... George Johnson

ctx.x: Yeah he was a great piano player. I haven’t heard him in a long time but he was a great piano player. And he turned me on to Béla Bartok, he was learning some “Mikrokosmos” at the time. So it’s just, you get exposed to this stuff. My first semester composition class at North Texas, my very first class, the guy, the teacher, God I can picture him perfectly and I can’t remember his name now — I want to say George Johnson or something, but I’m not sure. Anyway my very first class he had all these articles on…
There was a whole world out there that you weren’t aware of.
